Versatile Java developer focused on scalable backend systems, service reliability and cloud-native deployments.

Java Developer, Zoho — Sep 2025 - Jun 2026
Led development of a customer billing microservice used by internal billing workflows. Implemented Spring Boot REST APIs and redesigned service boundaries to reduce latency 28%. Built feature toggles and health checks to improve deploy safety. Integrated SQS for async billing events and persisted audit records in MySQL. Containerized services with Docker and deployed to Kubernetes for staging, enabling repeatable CI pipelines.

Backend Engineer, Vertex Analytics — Dec 2024 - Aug 2025
Designed and implemented core data ingestion microservices on AWS, processing analytics events into S3-backed data lake. Used Hibernate for schema mapping and optimized queries to cut average processing time by 35%. Managed EC2 instances for batch jobs and orchestrated services in Kubernetes. Implemented service-to-service communication patterns and automated deployments with Git-driven pipelines in an Agile team.

Java Developer, PhonePe — Mar 2024 - Nov 2024
Worked on payment reconciliation modules interacting with MySQL stores. Improved database indexing and Hibernate mappings to reduce reconciliation window by 40%. Implemented retries and dead-letter handling using SQS. Collaborated in Agile sprints, contributed to code reviews and maintained services on Linux hosts.

Java, SpringBoot, Microservices, MySQL, SQS, S3, EC2, Docker, Hibernate, Kubernetes, Agile, Git, Linux
